info.howItWorksDescription: Anyone in the research community can submit a conference by providing its name, location, dates, website, and deadlines. The submission enters a pending state and is then reviewed by a moderator before it becomes visible on the globe. Moderators cannot review events they submitted themselves, keeping the process fair and impartial. ReSEARCH Events is a collaborative tool built for and by the research community.
info.moderatorDescription: Want to help review event submissions? Send us an email and we'll get back to you.
